name: @pokernight/fieldops
description: Pure engine for Field Operations — a season of field work in northern Colorado, played by real agents. The region's people communities start where the public registry's latest phase result puts them and move toward Phase 7 through the work of teams: visits, gospel conversations, studies, circles, baptisms, churches recognized, churches that send. Every outcome is drawn from the seed; nothing else is random. No I/O, no timers.
